integrity: Proof of the universal truncated-spectrum classification is by cycle decomposition, formal-series triangular recovery, and the exact cycle-doubling identity. The 35-block STS(15) witness is independently checked for exact pair coverage and by direct matching enumeration. Finite experiments are verification only, not the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite labelled induced one-point relational extensions of two-point deletions of Steiner triple systems; does not count complete types of a functional Fraisse limit. No universality of both cycle profiles at all orders, classification of all designs, or independently established priority.
title: Complete proper-degree collision classification for pair-punctured Steiner triple systems
